## Done

All eight phases of `plan.md` are implemented in `work/phase-0`: 16 source
modules behind the canonical scene, catalogue, renderer, temporal, composer,
session and sphere contracts, with eight Node test suites and five browser
suites (`work/phase-0/test`). That covers the portable scene core and its ZIP
round trip, a metadata-only catalogue with rights-gated contribution adapters,
a Canvas reader with Equal Earth, Airocean and a fixed population cartogram,
mixed-cadence time with layers, flows and raster frames, immutable educational
scenes and portable bundles, a detached controller over a packaged WebSocket
relay, teaching and presentation modes at 4K, and a deterministic 2:1
equirectangular frame export with an SOS playlist, labels profile, external
legend and checksummed manifest.

## Waiting on others

Nothing is owed by a third party. Phase 7 acceptance requires someone other
than the implementer to run the contribution, classroom presentation, portable
restore and sphere-export exercises, and a real sphere installation and
operator if one is available (`plan.md` Phase 7, `test-plan.md` §4.7).

## Remaining work

Phase 7 is the only open phase. Sphere hardware behaviour is unproved, so the
remaining work is to run those four exercises with an independent participant
and record the corrections, comprehension problems, preparation effort,
performance, and operator burden - then address the findings or carry them as
refining work before any output graduates.

## Optional later

`plan.md` §4 defers live provider refresh services, columnar or tiled
renderers, local-network relay transport, direct sphere control, student
authoring and moderation, variable-driven or subnational cartograms, private
catalogues, and collaboration. `spec.md` also holds out universal provider
coverage, a complete historical-boundary ontology, arbitrary contributor code
in the browser, real-time collaboration with accounts, and guaranteed offline
two-device discovery.
